facts.length: 32 km along the east coast of Hinchinbrook Island National Park; accessed by private ferry to/from Ramsay Bay or George Point, schedule varies with tides; described as iconic by Australian Geographic and one of the best multi-day hikes in Australia by The Guardian
facts.camping: Permits sold per Thorsborne Trail Pass (2-5 nights), seasonal release; max independent group 6; 2027 permit release 9 Sep-31 Dec 2026 (per search snippet of QPWS pages)

sources.camping: https://parks.qld.gov.au/parks/hinchinbrook-thorsborne/camping (BLOCKED to scripts; read via search result snippet)

ingham-3.cost_note: QPWS national park camping fee $7.50 per adult per night, reported in search summary of QPWS pages; not confirmed on the page (403). Re-check in browser.
unverified: exact permit fee on QPWS page

facts.what: Day-use area and short walk to waterfall in Mount Spec/Jourama Falls section of Paluma Range National Park, between Ingham and Townsville; camping area beside Waterview Creek; shelter shed and picnic table; open 24 hours; lookout walking track update listed 18 Mar 2026 to 22 Oct 2027

ingham-4.cost_note: No day-use fee found; camping is separate (fee applies, amount not found). No Queensland-wide entry pass exists.

facts.what: Mix of natural and manmade wetlands in Ingham supporting freshwater species and birdlife, named for the Eastern Grass Owl (Tyto longimembris); site of TYTO Regional Art Gallery (Hinchinbrook Shire Council, opened March 2011), conference centre, cafe and visitor information centre (2020 report; may have changed)

sources.what: https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/TYTO_Wetlands ; web search results (birdingplaces.eu, Hinchinbrook Shire Council docs)

ingham-5.cost_note: No entry fee found for wetlands; not confirmed on an official page.
ingham-5.ticketUrl_note: tyto.com.au redirects to generic council 'Hinchinbrook Way' page, no TYTO page; council site hinchinbrook.qld.gov.au tyto-regional-art-gallery 404. Could use council site if owner wants.
unverified: gallery/wetlands entry fee not on an official page
wiki: TYTO Regional Art Gallery article exists but covers the gallery

facts.what: Waterfall about 1 km upstream of the beach and lagoon at Zoe Bay on Hinchinbrook Island; on the Thorsborne Trail, also reachable by boat (about 45 min per one operator); freshwater pools at base and top; QPWS asks walkers to stay on trail and not camp at Zoe Falls

sources.what: https://hikingtheworld.blog/waterfalls/zoe-falls/ ; https://hinchinbrookecotours.rezdy.com/648764/zoe-bay-falls ; QPWS Thorsborne walking page (BLOCKED, via search snippet)

ingham-7.cost_note: Reached on foot via Thorsborne Trail (permit/camping for overnight) or boat tour; the falls themselves charge nothing found. Marked free; boat transport not counted.
unverified: swimming safety (crocodiles in Zoe Bay itself)

facts.what: Day-use (picnic) area in the Mount Spec section of Paluma Range National Park; flush toilets; swimming is at Paradise waterhole and The Rockslides natural waterslide is further downstream; open 24 hours but wet-weather access may be cut when causeways flood; limited mobile coverage

ingham-8.cost_note: No day-use fee found; camping area separate with fees.

facts.what: Day-use area about two-thirds of the way along Mt Spec Road towards Paluma, Paluma Range National Park; short walk to swimming spot near a stone bridge; picnic tables, sheltered barbecues, accessible toilets; warnings against jumping or diving; QPWS lists a temporary closure from 7 Feb 2025 to 6 Dec 2026 (older listing) or 16 Jun 2027 (newer page)

ingham-9.flag: Temporary closure reported to Dec 2026 or Jun 2027: check in browser before keeping or bio wording
unverified: current closure status and end date

facts.what: Aquarium with more than 16,000 aquatic animals in 9 ecosystems across 11 zones, showing Tropical North Queensland's Wet Tropics rainforest and Great Barrier Reef animals; has a Turtle Rehabilitation Centre (tours A$20)
facts.price: General admission adult (15+) A$61, child A$35, concession A$48, family A$173

facts.what: 4800 sq m salt water swimming lagoon on the Cairns Esplanade, free, year-round, lifeguard-monitored, with toilets and showers; periodic closures for maintenance (5-week closure every two years, 2026/27 renewal budgeted); a constructed, croc-free pool; no dogs

sources.what: https://www.cairns.qld.gov.au/about-council/news-notices/news/media-releases/beloved-esplanade-lagoons-maintenance-program (via search summary; council site BLOCKED to scripts) ; https://swimmingholeheaven.com/qld-cairns-lagoon.htm

cairns-4.cost_note: Free per council description in search results; gate/ticket-free public lagoon.
cairns-4.ticketUrl_note: Council is the steward; Esplanade page https://www.cairns.qld.gov.au/experience-cairns/Cairns-Esplanade/esplanade-sport-and-fitness-facilities is BLOCKED (403). Orchestrator may check in browser; otherwise none.

facts.what: Botanic gardens in Edge Hill comprising Flecker Garden, Centenary Lakes and the Watkins Munro Martin Conservatory; entry free; free Friends-run guided walks of Flecker Garden on weekday mornings (reported); possible construction works July-Nov 2026 (commercial listing)

cairns-5.cost_note: Entry free (Friends page: 'Entry is free'). Gardens have gate hours so costBasis entry.
unverified: Centenary Lakes inclusion; evidence says Flecker Botanical Gardens is same place - WP title 'Cairns Botanic Gardens' not checked

facts.what: Social history museum in the historic School of Arts building in central Cairns, run by the Cairns Historical Society; four permanent galleries plus a changing ground-floor gallery; kids' discovery trails
facts.price: Adult $15, child (under 14) $6, family $30, concession $12; members free
